messages:
ida: quick heads-up — our q4b-int4 canary on canary-2 is showing a big drop in generation diversity vs fp16. noticed after last golden dedupe pass.

sam: which signals are down?

ida: ngram-uniq@100 down ~18%, distinct-2 down ~15%, human qual flags repetitive completions on clarifying-turn intents.

mike: did we change dedupe thresholds?

natalie: yeah last maintenance we tightened fuzzyhash/simhash and removed short turns. that removed ~1.2k candidates.

natalie: ```sql
-- last dedupe pass
DELETE FROM golden_pool
WHERE simhash < 0.92 OR length(prompt) < 30 OR length(response) < 20;
```

sam: could be 2 things: (1) dedupe removed diverse long anchors that break repetition, (2) quant kernels amplify repeated-token loops when context variety is lower.

ida: my working hypothesis is (2) after we lost edge anchors, the quantized model fell into repetition more often.

mike: propose quick plan: restore a microgolden slice of 300 previously-removed anchors targeting long/semantic-unique ones; run fp16 vs q4b pairwise A/B; open labeler ticket to review the rest.

natalie: I can pull the 300 and push to curie-bot for auto A/B. give me 25m.

curie-bot: canary snapshot: 2026-03-23T14:02Z model=q4b-int4 traffic=1% latency=220ms ngram-uniq@100=0.62 fp16_baseline=0.75 regen_rate=3.1%

ida: mike, can you schedule the A/B with 3-shot variations and same sampling params? keep top-k identical.

mike: yes, on it. tagging @natalie for labeling SLA — we'll need 48h to triage restored anchors.

natalie: acked. will triage and flag any deid/PII. if labeler capacity hits, prioritize anchors with length>120 and semantic-similarity<0.85 to existing golden.

sam: if q4b still loses after microgolden, try kernel fallback (int8-fast attention) and a small prompt temp bump to break loops. also run KV-cache stress test.

ida: agree. also let's add a dashboard metric: "golden_recall_coverage" — fraction of golden anchors that produce unique completions on canary. that'll alert earlier.

mike: creating tasks now: G-3471 restore microgolden, G-3472 run A/B job, G-3473 labeler triage.

natalie: G-3473 opened and assigned to labeling-ops, ETA 48h.

ida: thanks all. please post A/B diffs here once ready. if anyone sees similar regressions on other quant variants @channel. :eyes:
